name: Watercolor Fern Wall Art
etsyTitle: Watercolor Fern Wall Art Print, Botanical Nature Decor (Digital Download)
description:
🌿 BOTANICAL FERN PRINTABLE WALL ART

Bring a calm, natural touch to your space with this elegant watercolor-style fern print. Soft green tones and a warm neutral background make it easy to style in modern, Scandinavian, organic, minimalist, and nature-inspired interiors.

Perfect for a living room, bedroom, entryway, office, reading corner, or gallery wall.

✨ DIGITAL DOWNLOAD

This listing is for a digital product only.
No physical item will be shipped.

After purchase, you will receive a PDF file containing a link to download your high-resolution artwork files from Google Drive.

🖨 HIGH-RESOLUTION PRINT FILES

• 300 DPI high-resolution artwork
• Multiple aspect ratios included
• Suitable for home printing
• Suitable for local print shops
• Suitable for online printing services

📐 INCLUDED SIZES

• A Series: A1, A2, A3, A4, A5
• 2:3 Ratio: 4x6, 6x9, 8x12, 10x15, 12x18, 16x24, 20x30, 24x36 in
• 3:4 Ratio: 6x8, 9x12, 12x16, 15x20, 18x24, 24x32 in
• 4:5 Ratio: 4x5, 8x10, 12x15, 16x20, 20x25, 24x30 in
• 11:14 Ratio: 11x14 in

📥 HOW IT WORKS

• Purchase the listing
• Download the provided PDF
• Open the Google Drive link inside the PDF
• Download the size you need
• Print, frame & decorate your space

🖼 PLEASE NOTE

Each aspect ratio is adjusted individually, so minor visual differences in details, spacing, or composition may occur between files. All versions are designed to maintain the same overall artwork and visual style.

Colors may also vary slightly depending on your monitor, printer, paper type, and print settings.

💡 PRINTING TIP

For the best results, use high-quality matte or fine art paper and select the correct file for your desired frame size.

🤍 IMPORTANT

• Digital product only
• No physical frame or print is included
• No shipping required
• For personal use only
